title: A Marvellous Work and a Wonder
traveler_why: Tonight is about being amazed at what Heavenly Father does, and Scout the Seeker is the Traveler who looks up after a rainstorm, sees a rainbow arching across the whole sky and gasps “how does Heavenly Father DO that?” — Isaiah 29:14 at a child’s scale.
traveler_about: Scout fits tonight because Scout loves to discover Heavenly Father’s marvelous wonders. In Scout’s world today: after a rainstorm, Scout spotted a huge, bright rainbow arching across the whole sky. “How does Heavenly Father DO that?” Scout gasped, staring in wonder. It felt like a marvelous surprise made just for that moment. Just like Isaiah said Heavenly Father does a marvellous work and a wonder, Scout discovered that His amazing works are everywhere.
